integrity: The proof reduces the paired-divisor condition to an exact reversible subset equation. The cutoff is replayed by an independent exact-integer enumerator; no floating-point evidence is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to n=2^a p with p an odd prime. The finite cutoff is exhaustive in that slice through 11776; the binary criterion is global in a but does not by itself decide when its quotient is prime. Unindexed or differently phrased prior observations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: The first multi-pair strongly pseudoperfect number of the form \(2^a p\)
